decision.summary: Two regions merit closer inspection: (1) a sharp multi-sample displacement at indices 618–624 involving all axes, likely a permanent jump or rapid slip; (2) the subsequent extended interval (625–729) exhibiting sustained offset, possible platform segments, and ambiguous superposed motion—particularly in cross-axis trends—suggesting complex deformation or overlapping signals.

regions.observation: Abrupt multi-sample jump in all axes around index 620–623: N shifts from ~1.5 to ~12, E from ~-4 to ~0.7, U from ~-21 to ~-13.8; appears as a permanent offset with no clear return within the window, though surrounding samples show high variability and possible superposed motion.

Extended region (625–729) showing sustained elevated N/E/U values with complex morphology: after the jump, N remains >12, E fluctuates between 0–4, U stays near -14 to -18; includes apparent platform-like behavior (e.g., 630–645), possible opposing returns (e.g., U dips then recovers), and ambiguous superposed changes—especially around 660–670 and 690–700 where E and U show opposing trends without clear resolution.
